## Carried from PR #35581's contract review (nit N3) · 2026-11-20T04:04Z

Area: d7-D. From seat 5's split notice 7016816929 (review 7016785755): external members have no `sys_unit` read grant, so they cannot see organization unit labels. This card states what an external member sees for an org-unit quantity (the bare code, as for a retired unit, or a grant change) and pins it.

repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbdHk3orAeensH6EzS

Carried from PR #37389 (#35498) L1 and contract review (7180149059, 7180135740) · 2026-11-26T01:48Z · area o5-D

When #35498 lands, the standard-code decimals live in `sys_standard_unit_setting` (no reader ships with it). This card's reader owes three things:
1. **Select the row by organization.** Under `group` posture a member can read several rows per code (one per organization they belong to), and under `single` rows carry no organization stamp; the reader picks the row for the record's organization, not the first row returned.
2. **The L4 clamp:** display uses min(unit decimals, the field's `scale`); nothing rounds at write (ADR-0158 L4).
3. **`packages/spec/scripts/lib/platform-catalog.ts`:** add the `sys_standard_unit_setting` row, or record why it stays out.
Order of lookup (from #35498's design): standard code → its `sys_standard_unit_setting` row; organization code → `sys_unit.decimal_places`; otherwise none.

Claim amendment to comment 7182002678 (area o5-D) · 2026-11-26T03:53Z
File surface (adds):
- `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/form/form.tsx`: one entry in the live-record widget set (`RECORD_CURRENCY_WIDGET_TYPES` or its renamed successor) so a form quantity sees its row's unit, as a record-mode currency does.
- `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx`: the unit field joins the list page's own `$select` harvest beside the currency read field, so a list that hides the unit column still draws the label.
- The standard-unit label table ADR-0158 L2 (2A) promises ("Standard U1 codes get a platform-shipped per-locale label table"), which does not exist today: an English base name per code in `packages/spec/src/data/standard-units.ts` beside `STANDARD_UNITS` (one source with the codes; a test pins every code to a name), and per-locale names keyed by code in `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/*`, falling back to the spec's English name. Reason: the codes and their names cannot drift, and server-side readers (export, MCP describe) can name a unit without the UI bundle. The spec export widens: `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, contract review owed at the seat.
- Docs per `ui/AGENTS.md` #2: the `ui/packages/fields` README and one `content/docs/frontend` page for the quantity display.
Fences otherwise unchanged (⛔ `docs/adr/**`, `skills/**`, `packages/objectql/**`, `packages/platform-objects/**`). Overlap-check each added file before the push.

The UI resolver reads the served names, falling back to the spec English base. The ADR-0158 OI6 settlement and the follow-up item (an optional per-unit write-time over-precision refusal, refusing never rounding, within L4) go into the amendment text for weekly card #37245, not this diff.
Fences otherwise unchanged (⛔ `docs/adr/**`, `skills/**`, `packages/objectql/**`, platform object definitions).
